verdict.rationale: Semgrep can export scan results to SARIF, an open format (semgrep-docs-3, semgrep-docs-20), and a community user built an LLM triage pipeline on that SARIF output (semgrep-comm-14). It also generates SBOM reports (semgrep-docs-12), offers an API to pull findings, projects and deployments (semgrep-docs-17), and runs locally without an account or upload, with transparent configurable rules (semgrep-docs-34, semgrep-docs-33, semgrep-gh-2, semgrep-docs-7). However, nothing documents exporting *all* platform data, such as triage state, comments, tickets, private rules and history, as a bulk export for leaving, and no published OpenAPI spec was found (semgrep-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented full-account or bulk data export, export of triage history and metadata in open formats, a machine-readable API spec, and an explicit offboarding or portability guide.
